origins.name: Human
origins.blurb: The valley's own people: farmers, wardens, gravediggers. Nothing in them is remarkable except that they do not stop.
origins.trait_text: One more sip in the Ember Flask.

origins.name: Bullhorn
origins.blurb: Broad, horned, slow to anger. They came down from the salt cliffs as smiths and stayed as neighbours. The Hollow finds them hard to move.
origins.trait_text: A quarter more health and tougher skin, but a heavier stride.

origins.name: Sylvan
origins.blurb: Moss-skinned and long-eared, raised under the Greywood's eaves. They hear a wood change its mind before the birds do.
origins.trait_text: Quicker on their feet and quicker to catch their breath, but slighter.

classes.name: Bruiser
classes.role: Sword and shield, in the thick of it
classes.blurb: You were buried with a blade across your chest. Heavy swings that stagger, a shield that holds, and a slam that clears the ground around you.
classes.attack_text: Three weighty cuts; the third knocks them back.
classes.ability_text: Strike the earth: everything near you is hit and shaken.

classes.name: Arcanist
classes.role: Staff and ember, from a distance
classes.blurb: You were buried with your hands folded round a staff. Every swing throws fire; you are dangerous far away and fragile up close.
classes.attack_text: Each strike looses a bolt of ember at the cursor.
classes.ability_text: One great bolt that hits hard and flies far.

classes.name: Prowler
classes.role: Knife and footwork, never where they swing
classes.blurb: You were buried shallow and in a hurry. Fast cuts, a longer dash, and a fan of thrown knives for anything that keeps its distance.
classes.attack_text: A flurry of quick cuts you can dance through.
classes.ability_text: Three thrown blades in a spread.
